pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Clear Spirit Grass grows where the spiritual energy of nature flows gently and without disturbance. Its bright green leaves carry a faint spiritual glow, most noticeable beneath the morning dew. Though not particularly rare, it is a familiar herb to cultivators beginning their journey into alchemy.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Meadows, groves, forests, rivers, lush caves, and old-growth pine taigas.
